summary_evidence_spans: In the present study, 7 middle school mathematics teachers used ChatGPT to create personalized versions of problems in their curriculum to correspond to their students’ interests.
The prompting moves teachers made and their students’ open-ended feedback on personalized problems were examined through thematic analysis.

source_title: Enacting AI Literacy in Historical Inquiry Among Chinese Junior Secondary Students
title_zh: 中國國中學生在歷史探究中實踐 AI 素養

original_excerpt: This qualitative case study investigated how 12 Chinese Grade 7 students engaged with generative artificial intelligence (AI) over a six-week project on the collapse of the Qin Dynasty. … Drawing on an established AI literacy framework, the study adapted its dimensions to develop a framework tailored to historical inquiry, comprising four dimensions: AI Prompting Competence, AI Information Credibility, AI Bias Verification, and AI Ethics and Safety. … Three themes emerged: developing historical questions and extending inquiry through AI interaction, critically evaluating AI outputs, and strategic engagement with AI in historical inquiry.
interpretation_note: 轉述作者摘要的設計、樣本、改編框架的四個向度與作者報告的三個主題；作者對學科觀點的詮釋不寫入。
scope_limitation: 同儕審查期刊論文（Behavioral Sciences，監測清單 J52）；中國四川成都一所公立國中七年級學生 12 人、六週課後選修歷史專題的質性個案研究，作者寫明不在估計普遍程度或因果效果；研究團隊與該校歷史教師共同設計專題。

attributed_summary: 這項質性個案研究探討 12 名中國七年級學生在六週、以秦朝滅亡為主題的專題中如何運用生成式 AI；研究改編既有 AI 素養框架，形成 AI 提示能力、AI 資訊可信度、AI 偏誤查證、AI 倫理與安全四個向度；作者報告浮現三個主題：藉 AI 互動發展歷史問題並延伸探究、批判評估 AI 產出、在歷史探究中策略性運用 AI。
summary_evidence_spans: This qualitative case study investigated how 12 Chinese Grade 7 students engaged with generative artificial intelligence (AI) over a six-week project on the collapse of the Qin Dynasty.

Drawing on an established AI literacy framework, the study adapted its dimensions to develop a framework tailored to historical inquiry, comprising four dimensions: AI Prompting Competence, AI Information Credibility, AI Bias Verification, and AI Ethics and Safety.
Three themes emerged: developing historical questions and extending inquiry through AI interaction, critically evaluating AI outputs, and strategic engagement with AI in historical inquiry.

original_excerpt: This study presents the design and preliminary evaluation of a guided experiential workshop on AI-enabled physical systems for secondary-school students. … Students worked with programmable electronics, camera input, image datasets, machine-learning classification, and actuator responses. … A one-group pre-test/post-test design examined immediate changes in workshop-specific foundational knowledge and exploratory associations with student-profile indicators. … These findings support further refinement and evaluation; they do not establish causal effects, broader AI literacy gains, or independent design competence.

attributed_summary: 研究呈現一項以中學生為對象、主題為 AI 賦能實體系統的引導式體驗工作坊之設計與初步評估；學生操作可程式電子元件、攝影機輸入、影像資料集、機器學習分類與致動器回應；採單組前後測設計；作者寫明結果不能確立效應、更廣泛的 AI 素養提升或獨立設計能力。
summary_evidence_spans: This study presents the design and preliminary evaluation of a guided experiential workshop on AI-enabled physical systems for secondary-school students.
Students worked with programmable electronics, camera input, image datasets, machine-learning classification, and actuator responses.
A one-group pre-test/post-test design examined immediate changes in workshop-specific foundational knowledge and exploratory associations with student-profile indicators.
These findings support further refinement and evaluation; they do not establish causal effects, broader AI literacy gains, or independent design competence.
